import pandas as pd

xl = pd.ExcelFile('budget.xlsx')
print("Sheets:", xl.sheet_names)
for sheet in xl.sheet_names:
    df = pd.read_excel(xl, sheet_name=sheet, header=None)
    print(f"\n=== Sheet: {sheet} ({df.shape[0]} rows x {df.shape[1]} cols) ===")
    print(df.to_string(max_rows=60))

import zipfile, re

with zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx') as z:
    xml = z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml').decode('utf-8')
    print(xml)

import json, os, subprocess, sys, time
from pathlib import Path

ABS = str(Path('budget.xlsx').absolute())

macro_dir = os.path.expanduser('~/.config/libreoffice/4/user/basic/Standard')
macro_file = os.path.join(macro_dir, 'Module1.xba')

if not (os.path.exists(macro_file) and 'RecalculateAndSave' in open(macro_file).read()):
    os.makedirs(macro_dir, exist_ok=True)
    macro_content = '''<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE script:module PUBLIC "-//OpenOffice.org//DTD OfficeDocument 1.0//EN" "module.dtd">
<script:module xmlns:script="http://openoffice.org/2000/script" script:name="Module1" script:language="StarBasic">
    Sub RecalculateAndSave()
      ThisComponent.calculateAll()
      ThisComponent.store()
      ThisComponent.close(True)
    End Sub
</script:module>'''
    with open(macro_file, 'w') as f:
        f.write(macro_content)

cmd = ['soffice', '--headless', '--norestore',
       'vnd.sun.star.script:Standard.Module1.RecalculateAndSave?language=Basic&location=application',
       ABS]
try:
    r = subprocess.run(['timeout', '60'] + cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=90)
    print("soffice returncode:", r.returncode)
    if r.stderr:
        print("stderr:", r.stderr[:2000])
except FileNotFoundError as e:
    print("ERROR: soffice not found:", e)
    sys.exit(1)
